mapper.select: select payload from project_response_config where project_id=#{projectId}
select payload from requirement_response where requirement_id=#{requirementId} and project_id=#{projectId}
select payload from requirement_response where requirement_id=#{requirementId} and project_id=#{projectId} for update
select payload from requirement_response where requirement_id=#{requirementId}
select payload from requirement_response where requirement_id=#{requirementId} for update
select payload from requirement_response where project_id=#{projectId}
select payload from requirement_response where project_id=#{projectId} order by requirement_id
select payload from response_review where project_id=#{projectId}
select payload from response_review where project_id=#{projectId} order by id
select payload from response_review where project_id=#{projectId} for update
select payload from response_review where project_id=#{projectId} and id=#{id}
select payload from response_snapshot where project_id=#{projectId} and id=#{id}
select payload from response_snapshot where project_id=#{projectId} order by id
select payload from response_confirmation_history where requirement_id=#{requirementId} and project_id=#{projectId} and kind=#{kind} and entry_version=#{version}
select payload from response_confirmation_history where requirement_id=#{requirementId} and project_id=#{projectId} and kind=#{kind} order by entry_version desc
select payload from response_confirmation_history where requirement_id=#{requirementId} and project_id=#{projectId} and kind=#{kind} order by entry_version desc limit 1
select json_extract(payload,'$.matchReference') from requirement_response where requirement_id=#{requirementId} and json_contains_path(payload,'one','$.matchReference')

select requirement_id from requirement_response where requirement_id>#{cursor} and json_contains_path(payload,'one','$.matchReference') and not json_contains_path(payload,'one','$.matchReferenceInvalidatedAt') order by requirement_id limit 25
mapper.insert: insert into requirement_response(requirement_id,project_id,payload) values (#{requirementId},#{projectId},#{payload}) on duplicate key update payload=values(payload),updated_at=current_timestamp
insert into project_response_config(project_id,payload) values (#{projectId},#{payload}) as desired on duplicate key update payload=desired.payload,updated_at=current_timestamp
mapper.update: update response_snapshot set payload=#{payload} where project_id=#{projectId} and id=#{id}
mapper.insert: insert into response_review(id,project_id,payload) values (#{id},#{projectId},#{payload}) as desired on duplicate key update payload=desired.payload
mapper.update: update requirement_response set payload=json_set( json_remove(payload,'$.confirmedAt','$.confirmedBy','$.confirmedById'), '$.status','待确认','$.version',cast(json_unquote(json_extract(payload,'$.version')) as unsigned)+1, '$.confirmationReason',#{reason},'$.sourceRevision',cast('true' as json)) where project_id=#{projectId} and requirement_id=#{requirementId}
